statement: Offline dream cycles (Dreamer/Analyst/Consolidator) repair the memory graph before retrieval fails; soft decay makes forgetting reversible.
Task-oriented ontologies refined from judge feedback improve agent effectiveness and reliability.
Consolidation framed as a write-validation step guards evolving memory against logical drift.
Memories organised as a heterogeneous cognitive graph are revised from retrieval feedback.
Search summary reports perfect recall over ten-turn conversations and 90.9% memory-noise reduction on an eight-test suite (prototype scale).
